compiled_state.title: [aws-setup-lambda.sh]: ensure_lambda_function omits TELEMETRY_BUCKET env var -> KeyError at runtime
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## 1. Technical Environment
code_version: 0ea7a48e8677fee18aa65c99092dbba27d8e88df

## 2. Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker

### Expected
After aws-setup-lambda.sh, the Lambda function has TELEMETRY_BUCKET environment variable set to the configured review_telemetry.bucket_name; handler.py:20 reads os.environ['TELEMETRY_BUCKET'] without error.

### Actual
ensure_lambda_function() calls create-function without --environment Variables={TELEMETRY_BUCKET=...}. Handler runs but immediately raises KeyError: 'TELEMETRY_BUCKET' on first invocation. Object never lands in S3.

### Suggested fix
Add to create-function call:
  --environment 'Variables={TELEMETRY_BUCKET=}'
Also update ensure_lambda_function's idempotency path to assert/repair the env var if function already exists.
